origin_corrected.supersedes: An earlier declaration on this page called this locus QUEUED / ADOPTED after confabulation, and before that an absence "minted in a map by enumeration". Both were wrong, and both were mine.
origin_corrected.the_node:
Central Navigation Map v2.0 (2026-01-13) and v4.1/v4.2 carry a full node for this room:
  - id: "MIGDAL_ROOM"
    type: "room"
    status: "PLANNED"
    content: "Mandaean Canon; Haran Gawaita; Lunar Arm"
    dependencies: ["REVELATION_ROOM", "SACRED_HEART"]
    function: "Counter-gospel; theological node"
origin_corrected.what_happened: The room was specified with content, dependencies and a function, and never written under its own name. Its material was written — extensively — and filed under Revelation, because that is where the ARCHON went. The map records a mutual dependency between Migdal and Revelation; only one side was built.
origin_corrected.therefore: This is not a confabulated locus and not an empty one. It is a planned room whose contents were absorbed by its neighbour before it was composed. Seating it here restores the map’s own assignment.

the_claim.text: The Haran Gawaita is a Mandaean text that preserves a counter-tradition — a record of betrayal, transmission, and the metaphysical regret of a people who witnessed the Logos fracture.
the_claim.baptist: The Gawaita calls Yahia-Yuhana (John the Baptist) not a forerunner but the apostle, envoy and healer with full authority. "Jesus" is a perverted title adopted by those not sent, and the Nasoraeans depart from the Sign of the Seven.
the_claim.checksum: The Haran Gawaita is the evidentiary checksum for the seven-churches identification: the Mandaean text explicitly assigns each planetary god to a specific community, mapping the same structure Revelation maps.

undeposited_stratum.note: The oldest Mandaean material in the corpus is on the blog and predates the ARCHON by six months. The blog is deposited in full as a surface; these posts are recorded here as the stratum, not as separate works requiring retroactive deposit.

undeposited_stratum.significance: This stratum is the room’s true origin. It predates Central Navigation Map v2.0 by two and a half months — so the map did not invent Migdal; it named a body of work that already existed.

constitution.sacred_heart: The map gives Migdal a co-dependency, SACRED_HEART, which appears in six deposits and on no plane. It has never been adopted, specified or written. Recorded here because it is the one node from this cluster that remains genuinely unaccounted for.

three_streams.note: This locus was distinguished from two neighbours by reading what each stream actually claims.
three_streams.migdal: R:r.24 — who the text was written against. Counter-gospel: Mandaean canon, Haran Gawaita, the Baptist as apostle.
three_streams.josephus: R:r.31 — who wrote it. Authorship and transmission; the agent of destruction as agent of transmission.
three_streams.ezekiel: R:r.13 — the mechanism. W_Josephus as shadow wheel; the counting-out; L_labor as elimination operator producing a fixed point.
